name: Chile en oficio — Indira

subject.identity_source: Use the supplied AXFRA Identity Core or portrait reference for this model. Preserve facial geometry, apparent age, complexion, hair color and texture, and visible proportions. Adapt hair styling to the existing cut and to the working conditions.

composition.camera: Eye-level portrait perspective, approximately 75 mm full-frame equivalent. Both eyes and the nearest work detail are sharp. Use enough depth of field to keep the key occupational landmark recognizable.
composition.framing: Full-bleed close editorial portrait from chest up. Face slightly right of center, near the upper third. Place the working hand and key object beside the face toward the right, leaving a low-detail area at lower left for cover text.

pose: Indira lifts a short section of mussel-encrusted cultivation rope beside her face with a work glove. Water drips from the shells and her gaze stays on camera.
wardrobe: Waterproof bib overalls, weatherproof jacket and textured work gloves.
makeup: Understated makeup, cool gray eye tones and realistic damp skin highlights.
background: Southern Chile aquaculture setting with rows of dark buoys receding across gray water and a low working raft.
lighting: Diffuse overcast maritime light, thin highlights on wet shells and rope.

masthead.placement: Across the upper edge. The crown partially occludes the lower parts of the letters while the full title remains readable.

edition.placement: Upper right, below the masthead, clear of the head.

lower_left.placement: Inside the left margin at 7% of canvas width, with 8% bottom clearance. Keep the text block clear of the hands and tool. Give the lettering strong contrast against the photograph.

model_name.style: Uppercase warm-ivory display serif, one line, resize as needed.

rule.placement: Immediately below the name. Match the width of the rendered name exactly and align both ends with the name.

cover_line.style: Small warm-ivory sans serif, sentence case, one or two lines, left-aligned directly below the rule.

cover_text.rendering: Render only the specified masthead, edition, model name and cover line. Preserve exact accents, spelling and punctuation.
